authorization: Current user approved trying the memory-first three-way pilot, then explicitly requested relaxing compression to approach nanoGPT quality. Local bounded CPU training only; no cloud spending or full SOTA trial.
hypothesis: Replacing two compressed recurrent blocks with exact attention recovers language quality, at the cost of more retained context. One attention/memory ratio ablation.

arms.transformer: AAAA: four exact causal RoPE attention blocks, cached inference. Own nanoGPT-style microbaseline, not pinned upstream nanoGPT or current SOTA.
arms.compact: DDDA: three normalized gated-delta blocks and one full attention block.
arms.relaxed: DAAA: one gated-delta block and three full attention blocks. Same4 executed blocks and shared initialization.

matching: Identical train minibatches per seed,500 updates and512000 targets per arm. Same width64/head4/MLP4x and one optimizer setting; parameter counts within1%. Actual CPU unequal and disclosed. No walltime-matched quality claim.
sources: Reference gated-delta recurrence from pinned FLA commit in SOURCES.json, checked forward against unchanged upstream FP32 function. Own CPU triangular solve matches sequential recurrence/gradients/optimizer in FP64. This is a simplified memory hybrid, not a full published GatedDeltaNet replication.
selection: Keep minimum selection CE among steps0/100/200/300/400/500. Freeze all9 selected checkpoints before reserved confirmation.
data: Reused historical Shakespeare train and selection bytes are exposed research data. Fresh confirmation [1070414,1103310),128 non-overlapping257-byte windows,32768 scored targets. Byte vocabulary256; not comparable to prior FineWeb tokenCE4.317/3.750. No official test.
quality_gate: Relaxed-minus-transformer paired95 upper bound <=log(1.01), and every seed perplexity ratio<=1.01. This tests noninferiority on this tiny pilot only.
relaxation_gate: Relaxed-minus-compact mean<=-0.01 nats/byte, all3 seed gaps<0, paired95 upper<0. Preserve failure.
memory_gate: At8192-byte mechanics probe, relaxed process peakRSS <=25% of matched transformer for every paired seed. Mean prefill and cached decode ratios each<=1.25. Count runtime, weights, caches, and transient allocation in RSS. Separately report retained model+state tensor bytes; never substitute that for total-memory gate.
scope_limit: Quality trained/tested at256 only.8192 is a memory probe, not evidence for quality beyond training context. Proposed future4x memory at32K goal remains untested. With3 attention blocks, relaxed asymptotic KV savings are only25%, so a4x total-memory win is not expected; this pilot maps the quality/memory tradeoff.
resource: One CPU thread, training cap900CPU/1800wall seconds,150MiB artifacts; projected134CPU seconds from measured canary.27 isolated memory workers, each prefill cap120s; no GPU, no installs.
failure_preservation: Initial upstream-module import failed because einops is absent. Unmodified reference recurrent function was loaded through AST without the unused chunk-function import; source unchanged, no tolerance relaxation.
